name: vertical ground motions
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 地面运动的竖直方向分量。
usage_overview: 在车辆—高架桥系统地震分析中，作为地震输入的竖直分量与水平分量共同施加，用于考察其对桥墩轴力、桥梁振动及轮轨响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: The authors calculated the non-linear seismic response of the bridge in the Beijing metropolitan area to horizontal and vertical ground motions, using the data come from FEMA P695 [26] presented the specialised ground motions characterised by the velocity-impulse and large vertical ground motions.
